newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy hard left confirms against Albania force.
newsitem.headline: Italy hard left confirms against Albania force.

text.p: Italy's hard left Communist Refoundation party, a key parliamentary ally of Prime Minister Romano Prodi, confirmed on Monday that it remained opposed to sending an Italian-led multinational force to Albania.

A party statement said Refoundation's leadership had invited its members of parliament to vote "no' to the mission in votes due this week, a step that will split Prodi's parliamentary majority on a major policy issue for the first time.

The mission, the first of its kind to be led by Italy, will involve up to 6,000 troops on a mission to assist the delivery of aid to the Balkan state, rocked by lawlessness and armed anarchy. It is due to deploy in the week from April 14.
Prodi is certain of victory when the two houses of parliament hold votes on the force on Tuesday and Wednesday because of backing for the deployment from the main opposition.
But the split with Refoundation has confronted Prodi with his toughest political challenge in 11 months of office.

Refoundation is not part of the government but ensures its majority in the lower house of parliament, where it holds the balance of power. Angry coalition parties have questioned whether the uneasy alliance with Refoundation has a future.
